Why MESL
Official apps

Official apps for Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, Apple devices (iPhone, iPad, Apple TV) and OpenWrt routers. Sign in with the same account on each one.

Clear usage

See data used, the next reset date and your plan term in the dashboard. Renew or change plans in a few steps.

Account security

Two-step verification and passkeys. A new device signing in can be asked for a code sent to your email, and you can review and sign out signed-in devices at any time.

Ticket support

Open a ticket in the dashboard and our team replies. You get an email when there is a reply, and you can answer straight from your inbox. The help center has setup guides for each platform.
